name: Avant USD
oneLiner: avUSD is Avant's USDC-denominated base dollar, redeemable through the issuer and backed by a dynamically managed leveraged market-neutral portfolio.
collateral: A dynamic leveraged market-neutral portfolio spanning basis trades, lending-rate arbitrage, yield trading, lending markets, liquidity provisioning, and private liquidity deals. USDC is the mint/redemption asset, not the complete currently held reserve; the avUSDx junior tranche and separate reserve fund absorb strategy losses ahead of savUSD.
pegMechanism: 1:1 redemption for USDC via Avant Protocol with a 0.05% redemption fee and 1–7 day settlement window; avUSD itself receives no yield, while staking into the separate savUSD token is the yield-bearing route

oracleRisk.summary: The native Avalanche avUSD contract is an owner-administered ERC-20 with an authorized-minter map, not a collateralized-debt engine: its verified source has no price-feed, borrower collateral-health, or forced-liquidation logic.

branchApplicability.rationale: Avant documents avUSD as an Avalanche-native USDC mint and redemption asset. At Avalanche C-Chain block 90331106, the verified non-proxy avUSD contract exposes ERC-20 operations and owner-managed minter authorization, but no oracle, debt-position, collateral-health, or liquidation function. The PriceStorage documented for the separate avUSDx junior token does not establish a CDP oracle branch for avUSD.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: avUSD is Avalanche-native (AvantMintingV2) and reaches Ethereum, Base, Linea, Berachain, and Monad via Chainlink CCIP BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1 contracts (per-chain pool reads 2026-07-19); the token and pools are administered by the Avant MPC-custodied admin EOA.

applicabilityBasis.summary: avUSD is a non-yield base token with a USDC-denominated mint/redemption rail and an actively managed leveraged market-neutral backing portfolio.

genius.notes: avUSD has stablecoin-like reserve and redemption disclosures; no public GENIUS approval or foreign-issuer exception source was found. Terms of Use (avantprotocol.com) govern under BVI law and refer to 'Avant Protocol Foundation and its affiliates' as the operating entity; company profiles list Palo Alto, CA as operational HQ but no US legal entity name is disclosed. BVI domicile retained as primary; issuerPathway kept unknown pending clearer entity structure disclosure.

mintAuthority.summary: Avalanche avUSD has one active token minter, the immutable AvantMintingV2 gateway. A single current MINTER_ROLE EOA may invoke its collateral-backed, per-block-capped mint flow; the token owner and gateway default admin are the same documented MPC-custodied EOA, which can replace minters and raise the cap.

controls.label: Avant avUSD AvantMintingV2 contract
controls.capDescription: Verified source enforces supported collateral transfer, exact stable-value ratio at the current zero-delta setting, authorized MINTER_ROLE caller, and maxMintPerBlock. The current cap is 25,000,000 avUSD per Avalanche block.
controls.evidence: Complete MinterUpdated event history plus minters(address) confirms this is the sole active minter on the Avalanche avUSD token at block 90283689. Verified AvantMintingV2 source calls avantcoin.mint() only after collateral, route, signature, and per-block-cap checks. Both token and gateway EIP-1967 slots are zero and their verified constructors establish non-proxy deployments.

controls.label: AvantMintingV2 MINTER_ROLE caller
controls.capDescription: This EOA can call the immutable gateway, but each call remains bounded by collateral transfer, signature and route validation, and the 25,000,000 avUSD per-block gateway cap.
controls.evidence: A complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay and hasRole() at Avalanche block 90283689 confirm this is the sole current MINTER_ROLE caller on AvantMintingV2; eth_getCode returned empty bytecode. It is not itself an avUSD token minter and cannot change the gateway cap.

controls.label: Avant avUSD token owner and gateway admin
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 90283689, avUSD.owner() returned this EOA and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) on AvantMintingV2 returned true; eth_getCode returned empty bytecode. The owner can set token minters, while the gateway admin can grant caller roles and raise maxMintPerBlock. Avant documents Fireblocks/Fordefi MPC custody and policy controls for privileged operations.

review.evidence: Complete Avalanche role and MinterUpdated event replays through block 90283689, followed by direct hasRole() and minters(address) checks, establish one gateway caller and one active token minter. maxMintPerBlock() returned 25,000,000 avUSD, stablesDeltaLimit() returned zero, and the common admin/owner EOA can raise the cap or replace minters. Verified constructors and zero EIP-1967 slots establish immutable token and gateway code.
review.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 CTRL curation

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Avant states that capital backing unstaked avUSD is deployed into a diversified market-neutral strategy basket. The live portfolio API confirms large positive and negative positions across basis, lending, and yield strategies; USDC is the denomination and redemption rail rather than the complete reserve asset.
